title: opencode-recall Configuration
description: Configuration file for the opencode-recall plugin

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocompletion

database.description: OpenCode history and recall sidecar database paths

sources.description: Named read-only source databases. Both runtimes may share each source's dedicated sidecar. Overrides path/indexPath.

id.description: Stable source name used in qualified cursors.

indexPath.description: Dedicated sidecar; defaults to a hash of the canonical source path.

path.description: OpenCode SQLite session database. Opened read-only by recall.

indexPath.description: Recall sidecar embedding index. Defaults to opencode-recall-<source-path-hash>.db in the OpenCode data directory. Safe to delete and rebuild.

legacyPath.description: Deprecated: use sources. Resolved as a separate source named legacy with its own index.

model.description: Ollama embedding model. Try mxbai-embed-large for higher quality.

judge.description: Decision model that judges recall evidence. Enables the history_find tool when set.

maxRunTokens.description: Hard cap on decision-model input tokens per recall run; calls beyond it are skipped.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit for one decision call. A call that times out counts as a failure, and recall falls back to the standard history tools when the judge keeps failing.

queryHits.description: Search hits fetched per query before session fusion.

candidateSessions.description: Fused sessions sent to the judge.

passagesPerSession.description: Passages per session shown to the judge.

maxSessions.description: Matching sessions returned in the evidence pack.

sessionThreshold.description: Minimum probability that a session satisfies every criterion.

passageThreshold.description: Minimum probability that a passage is evidence.

outputChars.description: Evidence pack size budget in characters.

searchShards.description: Parallel search worker processes; history sources are split across them.

carriedSessions.description: Best sessions from earlier history_find calls in the same recall run that rejoin the judged pool.

weakMatch.description: When no window was scanned and the best match is below this, history_find also scans the fallback window.

partialMatch.description: With several criteria, sessions that meet at least one criterion and reach this probability on one of them join the pack after full matches, marked partial.

pickMargin.description: Top matches within this margin of the best are compared in one decision call that orders the pack.

pickSessions.description: Close top matches compared by the pairwise pick; 0 or 1 disables it.

scan.description: Session digest scan: judges compact digests of every main session in a time window.

maxSessions.description: Newest sessions in the window that get scanned.

maxInputTokens.description: Scan input token cap per call.

candidates.description: Best scanned sessions fused into the judged pool.

minProbability.description: Minimum scan probability for a session to join the pool.

fallbackDays.description: Window scanned when neither search nor a window found a matching session.

promptSamples.description: User prompts sampled into each digest.

sessionsPerDirectory.description: Newest sessions per directory that get scanned, so busy agent directories cannot crowd a window; ignored when directory is given.

excludeDirectories.description: Directory fragments of agent-run sessions left out of scans unless directory is given.

focus.description: Focused reads: whole-session segments judged against the criteria.

sessions.description: Top matching sessions that get a focused read inside history_find.

windowTokens.description: Segments packed per decision request, in tokens.

maxScanTokens.description: Tokens scanned per session; segments near search hits go first.

readScanTokens.description: Tokens scanned by history_read with criteria; segments near the cursor go first.

minScore.description: Minimum segment score to be shown.

textChars.description: Characters kept per message text in segments.

toolChars.description: Characters kept per tool call line in segments.

topSegments.description: Best segments of the top match that are shown expanded.

topNeighbours.description: Neighbouring segments added on each side of the top match best segments.

topSegmentChars.description: Characters kept per expanded segment of the top match.
